provenance.era5: ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus Climate Change Service / ECMWF), daily, via archive-api.open-meteo.com (models=era5); temperature at the point height (90 m DEM)
provenance.imerg: NASA/JAXA GPM IMERG daily rain via NASA POWER (power.larc.nasa.gov, IMERG_PRECTOT, UTC days)
provenance.powerCheck: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR yearly totals, kept only to show the record break (see build_neighbours.py)
provenance.firms: NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m active fires, South Asia 7-day files (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21), read 2026-10-19
provenance.sentinel: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Microsoft Planetary Computer, read as in build_field_watch.py
provenance.area: Officer area: the unit holding the farm, from UN OCHA COD-AB on HDX (Myanmar townships, Bhutan gewogs) or geoBoundaries gbOpen (simplified) elsewhere; villages: GeoNames populated places (CC BY 4.0)
